summary.text: Wayne Harper is a Republican member of the Utah State Senate for District 16 in Salt Lake County and serves as President Pro Tempore. The Legislature's roster says he served in the Utah House from January 1, 1997, to December 31, 2012, and in the Senate since January 1, 2013.

paragraphs.text: Harper earned a B.A. and an M.S. in history from Brigham Young University, according to the Utah Legislature's roster.

The roster lists him as a past member of the West Jordan City Council and as president of the Streamline Sales Tax Governing Board, and lists his work as Taylorsville City and business and economic development consulting.
